# The Axis Croatia: how it is created, and Tito's Partisans.

wif_cro_two_armies_ease = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_cro_two_armies_2 } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = wif_cro_two_armies_2 add_idea = wif_cro_two_armies_1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_cro_two_armies_1 } remove_ideas = wif_cro_two_armies_1 }
}
wif_cro_two_armies_remove = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_cro_two_armies_1 } remove_ideas = wif_cro_two_armies_1 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_cro_two_armies_2 } remove_ideas = wif_cro_two_armies_2 }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the routes
# Any scope. The Ustase rise: Croatia breaks away (or out from under
# Yugoslavia) as Italy's Reichskommissariat, in the Axis, at war with
# Yugoslavia, with the NDH tree. Tags only - ROOT varies by caller.
wif_cro_proclaim = {
	set_global_flag = wif_cro_ndh_formed
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = CRO CRO = { is_subject_of = YUG } }
		YUG = { end_puppet = CRO }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { country_exists = CRO } }
		if = { limit = { YUG = { owns_state = 109 } } CRO = { transfer_state = 109 } }
		if = { limit = { YUG = { owns_state = 104 } } CRO = { transfer_state = 104 } }
		if = { limit = { YUG = { owns_state = 1086 } } CRO = { transfer_state = 1086 } }
		if = { limit = { YUG = { owns_state = 804 } } CRO = { transfer_state = 804 } }
		if = { limit = { YUG = { owns_state = 103 } } CRO = { transfer_state = 103 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = CRO }
		CRO = {
			if = { limit = { has_war_with = GER } white_peace = GER }
			if = { limit = { has_war_with = ITA } white_peace = ITA }
		}
		wif_cro_install_ustase = yes
		# The Croatian regiments of the Yugoslav army go over
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = YUG }
			YUG = {
				transfer_units_fraction = {
					target = CRO
					size = 0.2
					army_ratio = 0.2
					navy_ratio = 0
					air_ratio = 0
					stockpile_ratio = 0.1
					keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		CRO = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = YUG NOT = { has_war_with = YUG } }
				declare_war_on = { target = YUG type = annex_everything }
			}
			country_event = { id = wif_cro.2 }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope, CRO exists. Pavelic, fascism, Italy as overlord, the Axis, the tree.
wif_cro_install_ustase = {
	set_global_flag = wif_cro_ndh_formed
	CRO = {
		set_politics = {
			ruling_party = fascism
			elections_allowed = no
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character = CRO_ante_pavelic } } recruit_character = CRO_ante_pavelic }
		promote_character = CRO_ante_pavelic
		if = {
			limit = { is_subject = yes NOT = { is_subject_of = ITA } }
			OVERLORD = { end_puppet = PREV }
		}
	}
	ITA = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_dlc = "Death or Dishonor" }
			set_autonomy = {
				target = CRO
				autonomy_state = autonomy_reichskommissariat
				end_wars = no
				end_civil_wars = no
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { CRO = { is_subject_of = ITA } } }
			puppet = CRO
		}
	}
	# Into the Axis: whichever faction Italy is in
	if = {
		limit = { ITA = { is_in_faction = yes } NOT = { CRO = { is_in_faction_with = ITA } } }
		random_country = {
			limit = { is_faction_leader = yes is_in_faction_with = ITA }
			add_to_faction = CRO
		}
	}
	CRO = { wif_cro_begin = yes }
}

# YUG/GER scope, from yugoslavia.8.b / .9.b (events/Yugoslavia.txt): Germany's
# Fate of Yugoslavia has just made Croatia a German puppet.
wif_cro_from_fate_of_yugoslavia = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = CRO
			country_exists = ITA
			ITA = { has_government = fascism }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_cro_ndh_formed }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { CRO = { is_subject_of = GER } }
			GER = { end_puppet = CRO }
		}
		wif_cro_install_ustase = yes
		CRO = { country_event = { id = wif_cro.2 } }
	}
}

# on_weekly_YUG
wif_cro_watch_yugoslavia = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_cro_ndh_formed }
			NOT = { has_government = communism }
			country_exists = GER
			country_exists = ITA
			has_defensive_war_with = GER
			has_defensive_war_with = ITA
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { country_exists = CRO }
					owns_state = 109
				}
				CRO = { is_subject_of = YUG }
			}
		}
		wif_cro_proclaim = yes
	}
}

# CRO scope. The state's start.
wif_cro_begin = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_cro_ndh } }
		set_country_flag = wif_cro_ndh
		set_variable = { wif_cro_ps = 25 }
		set_variable = { wif_cro_ps_rate = 1 }
		set_variable = { wif_cro_grievance = 0 }
		set_variable = { wif_cro_plan = 0 }
		random_list = {
			34 = { set_variable = { wif_cro_base = 104 } }
			33 = { set_variable = { wif_cro_base = 1086 } }
			33 = { set_variable = { wif_cro_base = 804 } }
		}
		add_ideas = wif_cro_ustase_state_idea
		add_ideas = wif_cro_rome_agreements_idea
		add_ideas = wif_cro_two_armies_2
		load_focus_tree = {
			tree = wif_cro_ndh_focus
			keep_completed = no
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Tito's Partisans
# CRO scope. Adds the temp variable wif_cro_ps_delta to Partisan Strength -
# never below 10, never above 100. HoI4 scripted effects take no parameters,
# so callers set the temp variable first:
#   set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_ps_delta = 5 } wif_cro_ps_add = yes
wif_cro_ps_add = {
	add_to_variable = { wif_cro_ps = wif_cro_ps_delta }
	clamp_variable = { var = wif_cro_ps min = 10 max = 100 }
}

# on_monthly_CRO
wif_cro_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_cro_ndh }
		set_variable = { wif_cro_ps_rate = 1 }
		if = { limit = { has_war = yes } add_to_variable = { wif_cro_ps_rate = 1 } }
		add_to_variable = { wif_cro_ps_rate = wif_cro_grievance }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_cro_camps_closed } add_to_variable = { wif_cro_ps_rate = -0.5 } }
		clamp_variable = { var = wif_cro_ps_rate min = 0 max = 20 }
		add_to_variable = { wif_cro_ps = wif_cro_ps_rate }
		clamp_variable = { var = wif_cro_ps min = 10 max = 100 }

		# Warnings at 50 and 70
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_cro_ps > 69.9 } NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_cro_warned_70 } }
			set_country_flag = wif_cro_warned_70
			set_country_flag = wif_cro_warned_50
			country_event = { id = wif_cro.18 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_cro_ps > 49.9 } NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_cro_warned_50 } }
			set_country_flag = wif_cro_warned_50
			country_event = { id = wif_cro.17 }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_cro_ps < 45 } } clr_country_flag = wif_cro_warned_50 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_cro_ps < 65 } } clr_country_flag = wif_cro_warned_70 }

		# AVNOJ, once, the first time the Partisans reach 90
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_cro_ps > 89.9 } NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_cro_avnoj } }
			set_global_flag = wif_cro_avnoj
			add_timed_idea = { idea = wif_cro_rival_government_idea days = 180 }
			country_event = { id = wif_cro.16 }
		}

		# Tito's headquarters moves now and then by itself
		random = {
			chance = 15
			wif_cro_move_headquarters = yes
		}

		# After a sweep found them, the Partisans lie low
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_cro_partisans_hiding } }
			wif_cro_partisans_act = yes
		}
	}
}

# CRO scope. Each operation's minimum strength and cost, into temp variables
# wif_cro_need / wif_cro_cost for the current plan.
wif_cro_plan_numbers = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_cro_plan = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_need = 10 } set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_cost = 3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_cro_plan = 2 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_need = 25 } set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_cost = 6 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_cro_plan = 3 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_need = 40 } set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_cost = 10 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_cro_plan = 4 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_need = 50 } set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_cost = 12 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_cro_plan = 5 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_need = 70 } set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_cost = 20 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_cro_plan = 6 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_need = 90 } set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_cost = 15 } }
}

# CRO scope. The Partisans pick an operation they can reach in about four
# months - usually the best of those, sometimes one or two lower - and save
# up for it.
wif_cro_pick_plan = {
	set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_reach = wif_cro_ps_rate }
	multiply_temp_variable = { wif_cro_reach = 4 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { wif_cro_reach = wif_cro_ps }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_best = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_cro_reach < 25 } } wif_cro_plan_2_possible = yes } set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_best = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_cro_reach < 40 } } wif_cro_plan_3_possible = yes } set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_best = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_cro_reach < 50 } } wif_cro_plan_4_possible = yes } set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_best = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_cro_reach < 70 } } wif_cro_plan_5_possible = yes } set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_best = 5 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_cro_reach < 90 } } wif_cro_plan_6_possible = yes } set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_best = 6 } }
	random_list = {
		55 = { set_variable = { wif_cro_plan = wif_cro_best } }
		30 = { set_variable = { wif_cro_plan = wif_cro_best } subtract_from_variable = { wif_cro_plan = 1 } }
		15 = { set_variable = { wif_cro_plan = wif_cro_best } subtract_from_variable = { wif_cro_plan = 2 } }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = wif_cro_plan min = 1 max = 6 }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_cro_plan > 1 } NOT = { wif_cro_plan_possible = yes } }
		subtract_from_variable = { wif_cro_plan = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { wif_cro_plan_months = 0 }
}

# CRO scope. One month of Partisan decisions.
wif_cro_partisans_act = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = wif_cro_plan }
				check_variable = { wif_cro_plan < 1 }
				NOT = { wif_cro_plan_possible = yes }
			}
		}
		wif_cro_pick_plan = yes
	}
	wif_cro_plan_numbers = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_cro_ps < wif_cro_need } } }
		# Ready: the more strength above what it needs, the sooner they strike
		set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_chance = wif_cro_ps }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_cro_chance = wif_cro_need }
		add_to_temp_variable = { wif_cro_chance = 35 }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_cro_chance min = 0 max = 85 }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_cro_village_militias } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_cro_chance = 0.75 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_cro_ps > 89.9 } } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_cro_chance = 1.3 } }
		set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = wif_cro_roll min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_cro_roll < wif_cro_chance } }
			wif_cro_execute_plan = yes
			set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_pay = 0 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_cro_pay = wif_cro_cost }
			add_to_variable = { wif_cro_ps = wif_cro_pay }
			clamp_variable = { var = wif_cro_ps min = 10 max = 100 }
			set_variable = { wif_cro_plan = 0 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		# Held below it: after four months they settle for less
		add_to_variable = { wif_cro_plan_months = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_cro_plan_months > 3 } }
			subtract_from_variable = { wif_cro_plan = 1 }
			clamp_variable = { var = wif_cro_plan min = 1 max = 6 }
			set_variable = { wif_cro_plan_months = 0 }
		}
	}
}

wif_cro_execute_plan = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_cro_plan = 1 } } wif_cro_attack_ambush = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_cro_plan = 2 } } wif_cro_attack_railway = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_cro_plan = 3 } } wif_cro_attack_zagreb = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_cro_plan = 4 } } wif_cro_attack_dalmatia = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_cro_plan = 5 } } wif_cro_attack_liberate = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_cro_plan = 6 } } wif_cro_attack_assassination = yes }
}

# CRO scope. Tito's headquarters moves to one of the other two mountain
# regions: Bosnia (104), Banja Luka (1086) or Herzegovina (804).
wif_cro_move_headquarters = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_cro_base = 104 } }
		random_list = {
			50 = { set_variable = { wif_cro_base = 1086 } }
			50 = { set_variable = { wif_cro_base = 804 } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_cro_base = 1086 } }
		random_list = {
			50 = { set_variable = { wif_cro_base = 104 } }
			50 = { set_variable = { wif_cro_base = 804 } }
		}
	}
	else = {
		random_list = {
			50 = { set_variable = { wif_cro_base = 104 } }
			50 = { set_variable = { wif_cro_base = 1086 } }
		}
	}
}

wif_cro_attack_ambush = {
	add_manpower = -2000
	add_stability = -0.01
	random_owned_state = {
		limit = { OR = { state = 104 state = 1086 state = 804 } }
		save_event_target_as = wif_cro_attack_state
		damage_building = { type = infrastructure damage = 1 }
	}
	country_event = { id = wif_cro.10 }
}

wif_cro_attack_railway = {
	random_owned_state = {
		limit = { is_controlled_by = ROOT }
		save_event_target_as = wif_cro_attack_state
		damage_building = { type = infrastructure damage = 1 }
	}
	add_timed_idea = { idea = wif_cro_sabotage_idea days = 30 }
	country_event = { id = wif_cro.11 }
}

wif_cro_attack_zagreb = {
	109 = { damage_building = { type = industrial_complex damage = 1 } }
	add_stability = -0.03
	add_war_support = -0.02
	country_event = { id = wif_cro.12 }
}

wif_cro_attack_dalmatia = {
	random_state = {
		limit = { OR = { state = 103 state = 163 state = 105 state = 853 state = 852 } is_owned_by = ITA }
		save_event_target_as = wif_cro_attack_state
		add_resistance = 10
		damage_building = { type = infrastructure damage = 1 }
	}
	ITA = {
		add_manpower = -1000
		add_stability = -0.01
		set_country_flag = wif_ita_dalmatia_attacked
		country_event = { id = wif_cro.21 }
	}
	country_event = { id = wif_cro.13 }
}

# CRO scope. A mountain state goes over to the Partisans - Yugoslavia under
# Tito, reborn as the National Liberation Army, or the existing communist one.
wif_cro_attack_liberate = {
	random_owned_state = {
		limit = { wif_cro_can_be_liberated = yes }
		save_event_target_as = wif_cro_attack_state
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { country_exists = YUG } }
			YUG = { transfer_state = PREV }
			YUG = {
				set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = no }
				if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character = YUG_josip_broz_tito } } recruit_character = YUG_josip_broz_tito }
				promote_character = YUG_josip_broz_tito
				set_cosmetic_tag = YUG_wif_partisans
				set_country_flag = wif_cro_partisan_state
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_state_controller = YUG
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = YUG NOT = { has_war_with = YUG } }
		YUG = { declare_war_on = { target = CRO type = annex_everything } }
	}
	YUG = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_template = "Partisan Brigade" } }
			division_template = {
				name = "Partisan Brigade"
				priority = 0
				regiments = {
					infantry = { x = 0 y = 0 }
					infantry = { x = 0 y = 1 }
					infantry = { x = 1 y = 0 }
					infantry = { x = 1 y = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = 1500 }
	}
	event_target:wif_cro_attack_state = {
		create_unit = { division = "division_template = \"Partisan Brigade\" start_experience_factor = 0.4 start_equipment_factor = 1.0" owner = YUG count = 3 }
	}
	country_event = { id = wif_cro.14 }
}

wif_cro_attack_assassination = {
	random_character = {
		limit = { is_political_advisor = yes }
		remove_advisor_role = { slot = political_advisor }
	}
	add_stability = -0.02
	add_political_power = -25
	country_event = { id = wif_cro.15 }
}

# CRO scope. A 30-day sweep of one region ends (the decision's remove_effect).
# The region is passed in the temp variable wif_cro_sweep_state:
#   set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_sweep_state = 104 } wif_cro_sweep_resolve = yes
wif_cro_sweep_resolve = {
	clr_country_flag = wif_cro_sweep_running
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_cro_base = wif_cro_sweep_state } }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_odds = 55 }
		if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = wif_cro_hrvatske_oruzane_snage } add_to_temp_variable = { wif_cro_odds = 15 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_cro_sweep_strong } add_to_temp_variable = { wif_cro_odds = 15 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_cro_base_known } add_to_temp_variable = { wif_cro_odds = 10 } }
		set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = wif_cro_roll min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_cro_roll < wif_cro_odds } }
			set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_ps_delta = -12 } wif_cro_ps_add = yes
			set_variable = { wif_cro_plan = 0 }
			set_country_flag = { flag = wif_cro_partisans_hiding days = 60 }
			wif_cro_move_headquarters = yes
			clr_country_flag = wif_cro_base_known
			army_experience = 10
			country_event = { id = wif_cro.40 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_ps_delta = -5 } wif_cro_ps_add = yes
			wif_cro_move_headquarters = yes
			clr_country_flag = wif_cro_base_known
			country_event = { id = wif_cro.41 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		# Tito is elsewhere - but the sweep may still catch a local cell
		random_list = {
			40 = {
				set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_ps_delta = -6 } wif_cro_ps_add = yes
				army_experience = 5
				country_event = { id = wif_cro.44 }
			}
			60 = {
				set_temp_variable = { wif_cro_ps_delta = -2 } wif_cro_ps_add = yes
				country_event = { id = wif_cro.42 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# CRO scope. The Rome Agreements, whichever form it is in.
wif_cro_rome_agreements_remove = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_cro_rome_agreements_idea } remove_ideas = wif_cro_rome_agreements_idea }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_cro_rome_agreements_mild_idea } remove_ideas = wif_cro_rome_agreements_mild_idea }
}
